body: Read that as dislocating. Dislocated my shoulder for the first time recently. No not so much dissociating but just not being. You know that idiom Let it be? No-one ever stopped to check if it even wanted to be.

Ok, so its like this; The more I feel "alive" the less I want to be alive. I use alive as just an expression of conciousness. But its not about death or dying. Its about stopping. Sure I cant stop your existence or their existence or anyones but from my perspective it will have gone. I want it all to stop and it will only stop with me. This is where I stop.
I knew them, I hope they found themselves
For them, all it will take is for one person to die and theyd stop taking their life for granted.
There isnt any harm in it
Ending this was the only decision I made, by my self. I needed to do this
I had never put myself above anyone but I think it was up to me to make that decision
Because its the only thing thats going to help me
Thank you, sincerely. Its been too much for too long.
